sessionStart.bash: if command -v node >/dev/null 2>&1; then node "${PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/copilot-session-start.cjs"; else desk_host=copilot; . "${PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/node-missing.sh"; fi
sessionStart.powershell: if (Get-Command node -CommandType Application -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) { node "${PLUGIN_ROOT}\hooks\copilot-session-start.cjs" } elseif ($env:NVM_HOME) { '{"additionalContext":"Desk needs Node.js 20 or newer, and this machine has no Node.js (no `node` on PATH), so the Desk tool servers (desk, desk-web) cannot run and Desk tools do not work in this session. Install it: run `nvm install lts` and then `nvm use lts` in a terminal. Then the person must open a new terminal and start a new session, because tool servers load only when a session starts."}' } else { '{"additionalContext":"Desk needs Node.js 20 or newer, and this machine has no Node.js (no `node` on PATH), so the Desk tool servers (desk, desk-web) cannot run and Desk tools do not work in this session. Install it: run `winget install --id OpenJS.NodeJS.LTS --exact --accept-source-agreements --accept-package-agreements` in a terminal. Then the person must open a new terminal and start a new session, because tool servers load only when a session starts."}' }
